objectives: Contact customer service by phone or chat
Make a simple complaint about a product
Use do and does to ask questions about a service

grammar.explanation: We use do and does to make present simple questions about services. Use does with he, she, and it, and do with I, you, we, and they. For example: Does the shop open on Sunday? Do you answer chats at night?
grammar.explanationAr: نستخدم do و does لتكوين أسئلة المضارع البسيط عند السؤال عن الخدمات، فنضع does مع he و she و it، ونضع do مع I و you و we و they.

examples.en: Do you have a branch here?
Does the warranty cover water damage?
Do you answer emails on Friday?
examples.ar: هل تجيبون على البريد الإلكتروني يوم الجمعة؟

vocabulary.example: She wrote a complaint about the order.
The customer is waiting for an answer.
Please call me in the morning.
What is the problem with the product?
The store policy is on the website.
Use the chat for quick help.
The support team works all week.

lt.en: Hello, I need some help, please.
lt.ar: مرحبًا، أحتاج بعض المساعدة من فضلك.

lt.en: I would like to make a complaint.
Can I speak to a service agent?
lt.ar: هل يمكنني التحدث إلى موظف خدمة العملاء؟

lt.en: One moment, I will connect you.
Is there anything else I can do?
lt.ar: هل هناك شيء آخر يمكنني فعله؟

lt.en: My phone stopped charging yesterday.
I bought it here last month.
Do you have your account number handy?
lt.alt: Have you got your account number handy?

lt.en: Yes, I have the receipt here.
Can you describe the problem?
The product stopped working after a week.
lt.ar: توقف المنتج عن العمل بعد أسبوع.

lt.en: It does not turn on at all.
Did you drop it in water?
No, I kept it in a dry place.
Does the warranty cover this?
Yes, it is still covered.
Can I still get a refund?
lt.ar: هل ما زال بإمكاني استرداد المال؟

lt.en: You can exchange it for a new one.
A refund is better for me.
Please fill in this short form.
How long does the refund take?
It takes five working days.
Is there a phone number for support?
Our support line is open all day.
lt.ar: خط الدعم لدينا مفتوح طوال اليوم.

lt.en: Do you answer chats at night?
Yes, our chat is open until ten.
I called three times this week.
Nobody answered the phone.
Our agent will call you back soon.
Let me check that for you.
Can you see my order number?
The number is on the box.
Thank you, I found it.
Does this shop open on Sunday?
lt.ar: هل يفتح هذا المتجر يوم الأحد؟

lt.en: No, we open from Monday to Friday.
lt.ar: لا، نفتح من الاثنين إلى الجمعة.

lt.en: Where is your main office?
It is near the city center.
What is the best solution here?
We will send a new battery.
Do I have to pay for it?
No, it is completely free.
Have a nice day, sir.

fb.en: The customer service was very helpful.
How long does a refund take?
Does the shop open on Sunday?

wo.en: Can you connect me to support?
The agent was very kind today.
Please send me an email instead.
wo.ar: يرجى إرسال بريد إلكتروني إليّ بدلًا من ذلك.

mc.question: Which question is correct?
options: Does the shop open on Sunday?
Does the shop opens on Sunday?
Do the shop opens on Sunday?
